rows.abstract: The bill seeks to allow employees receiving compensation income of not more than P300,000 per annum to deduct from their annual taxes VAT (value-added tax) payments on their purchase of good and services.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2007-09-05

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 58(A), SECTION 77(A), AND SECTION 81 OF REPUBLIC ACT 8424, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"TAX REFORM ACT OF 1997\", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill grants the host city/municipality and province where the withholding agent operates his business a 40% share of the taxes withheld.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2007-09-05

rows.author: F073
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING TWO ADDITIONAL BRANCHES OF THE REGIONAL TRIAL COURT IN THE CITY OF DAVAO, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 129, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE JUDICIARY REORGANIZATION ACT OF 1980,\" AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2007-09-05

rows.author: F063
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE SALE OF DRUGS OR MEDICINES FROM VALUE-ADDED TAX, AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-FOUR HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FOUR, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE TAX REFORM ACT OF 1997\"
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to exempt the sale of medicines to the general public from the ambit of the value-added tax.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2007-09-05

rows.author: E057
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOLS, COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES THE TEACHING OF BASIC COMPUTER PROGRAMMING AS PART OF THE CURRICULUM OF ALL SECONDARY LEVEL STUDENTS IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the inclusion of basic computer programming courses in the curriculum of all high schools in the country to make the youth computer literate.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2007-09-05

rows.author: E057
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING ADDITIONAL INSURANCE BENEFITS TO ALL PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS, PROVIDING FUNDS FOR THE PAYMENT OF ITS PREMIUMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill grants public school teachers the following insurance coverage: a) P200,000 death benefits; b) P50,000 burial expenses; and c) P100,000 reimbursement of actual medical expenses.

committee_action.meethigh: Referred to DBM for comment and/or position paper.

committee_action.remarks: Follow-up letter to DBM for its comments and/or position paper on the bill.
